    - Slowly. The captains bring me soundings and bearings, and I check one against another, and draw very small, and check again.
    - I am not a sailor, you know. I am seasick in a rowing boat. Old Hedley, who taught me, said that was the best kind of chartmaker: one who has to trust other people's eyes.
    - Twenty-one years. She came into this shop as a young sailor wanting a chart of the south coast, and argued with every sounding on it.
